# HoBo CI error catalog

A `hobo ci` command that stops prints a code with its message; with `--json` the code is the
`code` field. Codes are stable: a code's meaning does not change, and a new failure gets a new
code. A few codes report an outcome rather than a failure, and their message says so. The
runner order these codes guard is described in
[ADR-0183](runner-order.md#adr-0183).

This page is generated from the source, so it lists every code the code returns and nothing
else. Text in braces, such as `{repository}`, is filled in when the command runs. A code whose
message is composed when the command runs shows no message here; read the command's output.

Agents reach this page through the `hobo-ci` skill (`.claude/skills/hobo-ci/`, mirrored in
`.agents/skills/`), beside `hobo-ci-route-jobs` and `hobo-ci-insights`. The one-page setup guide
for an agent starting from nothing is [`site/public/ci/setup.md`](../../site/public/ci/setup.md).

## Codes

### HOBO_CI_ACCOUNT_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-command.ts`.

Message:

```text
hobo ci needs the relay account credential owner://HOBO_CI_ACCOUNT_TOKEN from the owner's store session, and none resolved. Run HoBo MCP's choose_secret_store for this project directory, then ask again. Human hobo login sessions are separate from CI account credentials.
```

What to do:

- Call the HoBo MCP tool choose_secret_store for this project directory.
- Have the owner keep the relay account credential in that store under {…}.

### HOBO_CI_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-command.ts`.

Messages:

```text
The CI credential selects a different account than the saved link. Reconnect with an explicit --relay and --repo.
```

```text
The installation response does not match the selected CI account. Check the relay before retrying setup.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPTED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
Adopted Vercel's deployment of {repository}@{sha}: {found.url}
```
